modmenu.summaryTranslation.mos: 100+ vanilla style ocean structures. Dive through Atlantean ruins, ancient shipwrecks, ocean temples, and drifting rafts for loot and adventure.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mos: Moog's Ocean Structures brings life, fun, and variety to your Minecraft oceans! Dive to explore Atlantean ruins, ancient shipwrecks, ocean temples, and drifting rafts scattered across every water biome. Every structure is built with vanilla blocks and entities, so the mod feels right at home in any modpack and keeps the vanilla feel of the game.
